text:
I've been building out a link blog idea called Linked List that I've wanted for a long time. Curation will be even more important in the future and I would love to have another option beyond Hacker News and Lobsters to find good reads suggested by fellow humans. It has been a fun space to explore ideas.

Not quite ready to open up sign-ups, but you can get an idea of the site here: https://linkedl.ist/@kale
